svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step a violet resist with two windows lies on a flat pale oxide that buries a metal line and a wider metal shape carrying a raised thin plate. After it the resist is gone and under each window a hole with vertical walls goes down through the oxide: at the left to the top of the line, at the right, less deep, to the plate.

svg.text: A fluorocarbon plasma etches the via holes
through the oxide to the metal caps and
the capacitor plates; the resist is stripped.
After: via-3 holes to the metal and to the plate
shallower: it stops on the plate
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
